Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation

Class KfeMonitoredChainAddressIndex

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation.KfeMonitoredChainAddressIndex
@Component public class KfeMonitoredChainAddressIndex extends Object
In-memory index of on-chain addresses belonging to active WATCH_ONLY wallets. Used by the ZMQ reactive path to filter mempool/block activity without scanning every wallet on every rawtx.

    • KfeMonitoredChainAddressIndex

      public KfeMonitoredChainAddressIndex(KfeWalletRepository walletRepository, KfeWalletAddressRepository addressRepository, com.kerosene.common.service.AddressDerivationService addressDerivationService, KfeTransactionRepository transactionRepository, @Value("${kfe.bitcoin.zmq.address-gap-external:${kfe.descriptor-scan-range:200}}") int externalGap, @Value("${kfe.bitcoin.zmq.address-gap-change:${kfe.descriptor-scan-range:200}}") int changeGap)
      Creates the monitored-address index with configured external/change gap coverage.
      Parameters:
      walletRepository - wallet metadata repository
      addressRepository - persisted wallet address repository
      addressDerivationService - network-aware xpub derivation service
      transactionRepository - cold funding transaction lookup
      externalGap - external receive-branch derivation count, clamped to at least one
      changeGap - change-branch derivation count, clamped to zero or greater

  • Method Details

    • refresh

      @Scheduled(fixedDelayString="${kfe.bitcoin.zmq.address-cache-refresh-ms:30000}", initialDelayString="8000") public void refresh()
      Periodically rebuilds the address snapshot; a failed refresh preserves the last published snapshot.

    • rebuild

      public void rebuild()
      Builds a replacement index from active watch-only, custodial on-chain, and internal wallets. Persisted addresses and derived watch-only gap addresses are normalized; known cold inbound txids are indexed for spend detection. Per-wallet derivation/history errors are logged and skipped, then a complete immutable snapshot is atomically published for concurrent readers.
